report.clinical_summary: Patient diagnosed with HIV 3 years ago, currently on Triumeq (1 tablet daily). Reports consistent headaches and fatigue for several months, becoming more frequent. Viral load recently showed detectable but low level (340 copies/mL). Adherence is inconsistent - occasionally misses doses, especially when feeling well. Also reports work stress and disrupted sleep contributing to fatigue. Understands medication importance for viral control but struggles with daily adherence. Expresses worry about future progression and long-term effects.
